title: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane in its altered present, ruled by dragonlords instead of khans.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: The feral, silent dragonlord who leads the reckless Kolaghan clan, striking with lightning and destroying territory she claims.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: The ultimate predator and gluttonous dragonlord who rules the Atarka clan and devours even her followers.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: The merciful but imperious dragonlord of the Dromoka clan, who roosts in the Great Aerie of Arashin and outlaws ancestor magic.

entities.name: Kolaghan clan
entities.description: A reckless, unstructured clan of warriors who follow Kolaghan and use lightning magic.

entities.name: Atarka clan
entities.description: The nomadic hunters, descended from the Temur, who feed their hungry dragonlord to survive.

entities.name: Dromoka clan
entities.description: A community of dragons and desert survivors bound by endurance and honor, with the dragon's scale as symbol.

entities.name: Zurgo Bellstriker
entities.description: A huge, short-tempered orc, the other-time khan of the Mardu, now serving as Kolaghan's attendant and bell-striker.

entities.name: Vial Smasher
entities.description: A reckless Kolaghan goblin who keeps a vial of dragonfire on her at all times.

entities.name: Gvar Barzeel
entities.description: A loyal follower of Kolaghan who keeps other humanoids in line; in another timeline he was an Abzan krumar.

entities.name: Surrak
entities.description: The Hunt Caller of the Atarka clan, who hunts all but dragons for fun and glory.

entities.name: Sakta
entities.description: A young human hunter and chief scout who is the center of the Wide Whisper among surviving shamans.

entities.name: Arel
entities.description: A human Whisperer who secretly seeks to free people from Atarka's rule and imagines a world without dragons.

entities.name: Anafenza
entities.description: In this timeline a capable Dromoka warrior executed for kin-tree worship, whose ghostly figure is said to fight alongside the Dromoka.

entities.name: Baihir Marza
entities.description: A seasoned ainok mage of the Dromoka, master of sunbringer and sandbringer traditions.

entities.name: Commander Faiso
entities.description: The youngest human to command a legion of Dromoka troops, a master of aerial strategy.

entities.name: Sarkhan
entities.description: The planeswalker whose rival Zurgo was in another timeline.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The Spirit Dragon whose Draconic language underlies Kolaghan shamans' occult speech.

entities.name: Screamreach
entities.description: The central swampland region of the Kolaghan's lands.

entities.name: Qal Sisma Mountains
entities.description: The mountains where the Atarka clan dwells, whose glaciers have melted since Atarka's arrival.

entities.name: Ayagor
entities.description: A shallow, high valley where Atarka assembles her clan to feed her, resembling a dinner platter.

entities.name: Arashin
entities.description: The largest Dromoka city and its greatest aerie, where Dromoka roosts.

entities.name: Aerie of the Unfettered
entities.description: A rocky spire settlement in Dromoka lands that is home only to dragons owed fealty by no one.

entities.name: Salt Road
entities.description: A road through the wastes controlled by the Dromoka to supply Purugir Aerie.

entities.name: Purugir Aerie
entities.description: One of the Dromoka's frontline war centers.

entities.name: Wide Whisper
entities.description: A trance communion that links the surviving Atarka shamans secretly.

entities.name: Kin-trees
entities.description: Secret trees holding ancestors' souls, worshipped by Dromoka spirit speakers despite the ban.

events.summary: Zurgo, once the Mardu khan of another timeline, serves as Kolaghan's bell-striker, rousing warriors with his greatsword when she stirs to battle.
events.quote: Zurgo has been reduced to serving as an attendant to the dragonlord Kolaghan.

events.summary: Atarka's arrival and storms melt the Qal Sisma glaciers, and she wipes out the mammoths and most of the former Temur shamans.
events.quote: Atarka quickly devoured most of the shamans of the former Temur clan

events.summary: The surviving Atarka shamans secretly warn each other through the Wide Whisper as Atarka's purge begins.
events.quote: As the dragon's purge began, the shamans warned each other secretly

events.summary: Dromoka's law outlaws ancestor magic as necromancy, and a few renegade spirit speakers hide kin-trees.
events.quote: Ancestor magic, once practiced by the distant forebears of the modern-day Dromoka humanoids, is outlawed by the dragonlord as a form of necromancy.

events.summary: Anafenza is executed for kin-tree worship, but a ghostly figure like her is seen fighting alongside the Dromoka.
events.quote: However, she practiced ancient kin-tree worship, and for that she was executed.

relations.note: He is Kolaghan's attendant and bell-striker.
relations.quote: Zurgo has been reduced to serving as an attendant to the dragonlord Kolaghan.
the Kolaghan goblin called Vial Smasher is a reckless wielder of bottled dragonfire.

relations.note: A loyal, reverent follower of the dragonlord.
relations.quote: he remains a loyal, reverent follower of dragonlord Kolaghan.
The dragonlord is a fearsome leader, using violence, cruelty, and her trademark unpredictability to keep the clan in line.

relations.note: The clan lives at the pleasure of the dragonlord.
relations.quote: The Atarka live at the pleasure of a dragonlord whose moods are as violent and changeable as their environment

relations.note: He is Atarka's Hunt Caller, her chief feeder.
relations.quote: Surrak holds the position of Hunt Caller in this new timeline.

relations.note: She hopes to free people from Atarka's rule.
relations.quote: hoping to amass support to free those who wish it from Atarka's rule.

relations.note: She advises him as chief scout.
relations.quote: She often advises Surrak as the chief scout.

relations.note: The clan is bound by common allegiance to their dragonlord.
relations.quote: bound together by their common allegiance to their devoted dragonlord.

relations.note: He commands her legions on her orders.
relations.quote: Even the clan's dragons yield to him on matters of strategy, on orders from Dromoka herself.

relations.note: In this timeline Dromoka took the place Anafenza would have held as khan.
relations.quote: In another timeline, Anafenza would have been khan, but in this reality Dragonlord Dromoka took her place.

relations.note: The largest city and center of the clan.
relations.quote: Economically, politically, and militarily, Arashin is the center of the clan.
